types.utc: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with up to nanosecond precision
types.path: local filesystem path; canonical absolute path in results

activity_contract.initialization: First successful explicit link initializes computer identity. Unlinked initial work returns untracked without creating state; bindings resolve locally by Git common-directory or nearest ordinary-directory scope.

actions.ui: Links; Add/Edit searchable project and task pickers
actions.notes: Explicit project required; no picker is shipped. Missing task uses a still-active saved choice or sole active task; missing timezone uses a saved choice for this account/project. Unresolved choices return input_required. Path defaults cwd. No user override. Omitted revision means create-only or identical no-op.
ID and path mutually exclusive; defaults cwd. Exactly one binding returned or not_found.
Requires --yes; rejects attached working/waiting/stale generations. Historical snapshots persist.
Explicit locator replacement only; same attribution, --yes, no attached generation, no conflicting locator. No remote/name-based guessing.

activity_contract.local_mutation_semantics: request_id is a UUID; CLI generates one if omitted. Exact replay returns original typed result before config, account, credentials, network or path discovery, after a local durability check. Same request ID with changed explicit intent returns request_conflict. Retry local_write_unknown with the same request ID; safe error details include it. No Harvest writes.

semantics.auth: HARVEST_TOKEN overrides macOS Keychain; --account overrides HARVEST_ACCOUNT_ID overrides config
semantics.date: YYYY-MM-DD, today or yesterday; relative dates use machine local timezone
semantics.duration: decimal hours, H:MM, or Go duration such as 1h30m; range 0..24 hours
semantics.pagination: complete arrays; errors never emit partial success
semantics.retry: GET only; never automatically replay mutations
semantics.time: HH:MM, same-day end strictly after start; split overnight entries
semantics.timer: current user, all dates; no automatic switch; preflight is not atomic
